title: AAR Contents, Resources, Consumer Rules, and Publication Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies aar contents, resources, consumer rules, and publication?
options: Verify the exact published artifact and metadata through external release-like consumers, including R8 and resource or manifest merging.
questions.answer: Verify the exact published artifact and metadata through external release-like consumers, including R8 and resource or manifest merging.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: An Android library that builds successfully as a project is guaranteed to work when consumed from Maven.
questions.explanation: Testing only with an included project can pass even when the published POM or Gradle metadata omits a runtime dependency.

questions.prompt: Who applies a library consumer R8 rule?
questions.answer: The consuming application shrinker applies rules packaged in the library while optimizing the final app.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
